'''EasterlingMaster Anti-Jabba's Palace''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[EasterlingMaster]]
* '''Published:''' 22 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|SE-L-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|The Signal|JP-L-thesignal.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Seeking An Audience|JPSD-L-seekinganaudience.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 TatJP EasterlingMaster LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Civil Disorder (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

My friend and his brother are using DS JP deck's right now, so, I thought I'd give this one a go.

== Notes ==

* No objective: starts Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, The Signal and Seeking An Audience.
* Posted Dunee Ta dested Ounee Ta; Ktionak dested Kitonak; B-wing dested B-wing Attack Fighter; X-wing dested the Premiere X-wing; Farm dested the Special Edition Farm site.
* Sai'torr Kal Fas x2 is unmarked, so it is the printed card; only Civil Disorder (V) (Virtual Set 6) is virtual.

== Strategy ==

The main objective of this deck is to put the DS JP player in a bind. Force draining in space, while replacing my opponent's site's with my own. Devaronians, holding the docking bay, not by themselves, of coarse. A Gift to keep those force drains and destiny draws down. Ultimatum, is in here to put a bind on force draining at Droid Workshop. Keep Chewie, Han, and Organa all together, helps a lot if I draw Protector. Oola, to stop those nasty Bounty Hunters. Loje Nella must put a stop to that evil Mosep (SP?). Grans, help retrieve force with Civil Disorder. And Garon Nas Tal, gives Sai'torr Kal Fas a boost. I've played with a older version of this deck, the one my friend made for me, almost won. So, we'll see how well this version does. Hopefully pretty well. Thanks.
